title: Multimedia 12
subtitle: Make purposeful media. Build your skills, explain your choices, and improve through feedback.

modules.title: Graphic Design & Photography
modules.summary: Compose images. Shape a message. Make your creative decisions visible.
modules.description: Move from editable photo composites to editorial design, advertising and cinematic lighting. Use the route your teacher assigns; keep your working files and show how your decisions develop.

groups.title: Foundation
groups.description: An introduction to layers, masks and believable depth.

lessons.title: Phone Portal / Out-of-Bounds
lessons.label: Decode the Impossible
lessons.desc: Build an editable phone portal, then bring a butterfly beyond the frame with masks and deliberate layer order.

groups.title: Shared bootcamp
groups.description: Build your workflow, then respond to a changed brief.

lessons.title: Below the Surface
lessons.desc: Create a documentary opener with a layered still, a short motion version and a practical revision.

lessons.title: Drop Day
lessons.desc: Repair a sneaker source, build recoverable masks, and control colour and typography for a product display.

lessons.title: On the Cover
lessons.desc: Design an editorial cover with readable hierarchy, careful portrait masking and purposeful typography.

lessons.title: The Brief Has Changed
lessons.label: Class 10
lessons.desc: Apply your bootcamp learning to a changed brief and explain the choices behind your response.

groups.title: Design exploration & purpose
groups.description: Connect technique to audience, meaning and design choices.

lessons.title: Design Studio Explorer
lessons.desc: Explore the design studio route before moving into more advanced projects.

lessons.title: Make It Matter
lessons.desc: Connect design theory to a cause-advertising project, with an extension for Multimedia 12.

groups.title: Advanced studio
groups.description: Develop control, polish and a defensible creative direction.

lessons.title: Truck Ad
lessons.label: Built for the Wild
lessons.desc: Build an advertising composite with deliberate visual hierarchy, image integration and production decisions.

lessons.title: Fresh Impact
lessons.desc: Develop a product campaign through label construction, surface appearance, depth and typography.

lessons.title: Last Light REDO
lessons.desc: Develop a cinematic composite with motivated lighting and a coherent atmosphere.

supplemental.title: Composite Realism
supplemental.desc: Revisit selection, masking, layer order and Soft Light blending.

modules.title: Collaborative Project & Portfolio
modules.summary: Bring your media skills together and show your growth.
